messages: marta: Quick huddle — thinking about trace header badges: currently order is [export] [correlation id] [pinned]. Users say export looks like the primary CTA which leads to accidental downloads. Thoughts? :eyes: alex: I noticed this in user testing yesterday. On small widths the export button jumps left and hides corr id. We should avoid moving clickable primary actions around. priya: Agree. Also copy 'Export trace' vs 'Download snapshot' is inconsistent across drilldown and detail view. Can we standardize? sam: A11y note: screen readers read the visual order. If export is first it announces before correlation ID which breaks flow. For keyboard users, tab order matters too. marta: Proposed change: visually group metadata badges (corr id, pinned, session) left, and action CTAs (export, share, copy link) right. For mobile collapse: put actions into kebab menu. What about making export a secondary button with aria-label="Download trace as zip"? alex: That works. For implementation I suggest swapping DOM order so metadata comes first, then actions. CSS can float them. Remember to update aria-hidden on decorative icons. priya: Copy proposal: - Export -> 'Download trace (.zip)' - Copy link -> 'Copy trace permalink' - Share -> 'Share trace...' Can we make file extension explicit to set expectations? sam: +1 on explicit extensions. Also add sr-only text: 'Correlation ID: ' so screen readers announce label then value. Example snippet: ```html Correlation ID: abc123 ``` marta: Nice. UX question: should export be available in both header and overflow? duplication might be confusing. alex: I'd keep export in overflow only on <=640px. Desktop keep visible but secondary style. Also add confirmation toast 'Export started — check downloads'. priya: Metrics ask: track clicks on export CTA and overflow export separately (so we can see if hidden reduces usage). sam: Keyboard: ensure kebab menu is reachable via Enter and Space, and that export inside menu is focusable. Add role="menu" and handle arrow keys. jenkins-bot: Deploy scheduled to staging at 2026-03-24T03:00Z :robot_face: marta: Cool — I'll update the mock and send a quick Figma link. Need final copy by EOD so we can sync with analytics. :calendar: alex: I'll prototype DOM order change in a PR today. priya: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: marta will update figma, alex to PR, sam to add ARIA checklist, priya to add metric tags. marta: Link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/trace-header-badges — ping if you can't access. sam: quick thought — for exports from private deployments we should warn about data scope. Add subtle copy in modal 'This export includes request/stack data.' marta: Adding that to copy notes. End.
